title: רב נתן בר אבא

paragraphs: Rav Natan bar Abba said three things in Rav's name, Beitzah 32b. He interpreted before Rav, Bava Metzia 41a. Before Shemuel, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Avodah Zarah 2. He went with R. Elazar to R. Shemuel bar Abba to console a mourner, Jerusalem Talmud, Mo'ed Katan 3, end of halakhah 1. There is Abba bar Natan. Perhaps Yaakov bar Abba (see his entry) was his brother.
